mapper.sql: select pr.purchase_return_id, pr.return_no, pr.return_type, pr.supplier_id, pr.purchase_order_id, po.order_no as purchase_order_no, ms.supplier_name, pr.warehouse_id, mw.warehouse_name, pr.total_qty, pr.total_amount, pr.status, pr.audit_by, pr.audit_time, pr.reject_reason, pr.create_by, pr.create_time, pr.update_by, pr.update_time, pr.remark from wms_purchase_return pr left join wms_purchase_order po on po.purchase_order_id = pr.purchase_order_id left join md_supplier ms on ms.supplier_id = pr.supplier_id left join md_warehouse mw on mw.warehouse_id = pr.warehouse_id left join sys_user su on su.user_name = pr.create_by and su.del_flag = '0'
mapper.insert:

return_no, return_type, supplier_id, purchase_order_id, warehouse_id, total_qty, total_amount, status, audit_by, audit_time, create_by, create_time, update_by, remark,

delete from wms_purchase_return where purchase_return_id in

mapper.select: select max(return_no) from wms_purchase_return where return_no like concat(#{noPrefix}, '%')
mapper.update: update wms_purchase_return set total_qty = ifnull((select sum(quantity) from wms_purchase_return_item where purchase_return_id = #{purchaseReturnId}), 0), total_amount = ifnull((select sum(amount) from wms_purchase_return_item where purchase_return_id = #{purchaseReturnId}), 0), update_time = sysdate() where purchase_return_id = #{purchaseReturnId}

update wms_purchase_return set status = #{newStatus}, audit_by = #{auditBy}, audit_time = case when #{auditBy} is not null and #{auditBy} != '' then sysdate() else null end, reject_reason = case when #{newStatus} = 'submitted' or #{newStatus} = 'audited' then null else reject_reason end, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate() where purchase_return_id = #{purchaseReturnId} and status = #{oldStatus}

update wms_purchase_return set status = 'draft', reject_reason = #{rejectReason}, audit_by = null, audit_time = null, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate() where purchase_return_id = #{purchaseReturnId} and status = 'submitted'
